about: What a mapping-layer registry (recipes/layers.json) and an agent registry (recipes/agents.json) may say (mappingLayers ML1-b; SPEC-mappingLayers-102326 §3.3, §4.5, §7). DATA: layerRegistry.js reads these lists and refuses by name anything outside them. The registration statuses are ISO/IEC 11179-6:2023 Table 1's lifecycle statuses (RULED R1: first-class grounding), in lifecycle order; Historical and Application are documentation statuses and are deliberately not listed.

scoreEntry.about: (mappingLayers ML3-b, the ML2 hand-off) one row of a version's optional scoreList: a measurement of this version AGAINST another layer version. The field list is closed. againstLayerVersion is either a pinned layer-version URI the registry holds, or a decision block named honestly as unregistered (ML2's Ed-Fi cfg-cf8d comparator a60a667b is in no registered version); any other text is refused. reportPath is relative to the webdev root, where the evidence lives.

copiedFromLayerVersion.about: (mappingLayers ML3-b, the ML2 hand-off) a version that re-registers another layer's version under a new layerKey (PLAN section 8: one layerKey per judge configuration) names that version by its pinned URI. It must parse as a layerVersion URI, name a version the registry holds in ANOTHER layer, and carry the same contentId: a copy that differs in content is not a copy.
